settings.title: Settings
settings.ext.title: Extension check
settings.theme.brightness_hint: Affects surfaces only (main window and pop-ups). Text stays at full contrast.
tray.balloon.background_title: MDM is running in the background
tray.balloon.background_body: It keeps running in the hidden icons area. To quit, choose «Exit» from the tray menu.
firefox.title: Firefox extension
firefox.temp.head: Temporary install (regular Firefox)
firefox.temp.body: Works for this session only. The extension is removed when you close Firefox — you have to install it again. Mozilla does not allow unsigned extensions to stay installed in regular Firefox.
firefox.perm.head: Permanent install (recommended)
firefox.perm.body: If you install Firefox Developer Edition, the extension stays in the Add-ons list and keeps working after a restart. Once installed, press «Install Firefox automatically» in MDM again.
settings.general.delete_from_disk: Also remove the file from the computer when deleting
settings.general.delete_from_disk_hint: When off, the item is only removed from the list; the file stays in the download folder.
settings.general.delete_archive: Delete the archive file after closing it
settings.general.delete_archive_hint: Once the archive has been opened in the viewer, the .rar/.zip file is deleted when you close it.
settings.general.auto_folders_hint: When off, downloads are written straight to the default folder; no Videos/Archives subfolder is created.
settings.general.folder_create_failed: The folder could not be created.
settings.notify.title: Notifications
settings.notify.tray: Show a tray notification when minimized
settings.notify.tray_hint: A «running in the background» balloon when the app moves to the hidden icons.
settings.notify.done: Show a notification when a file finishes
settings.notify.done_hint: A Windows tray notification when the download finishes (with the Windows sound). When off, there is no notification and no sound.
settings.ext.cleanup_detail: The browser extension uses this folder:
settings.ext.firefox_dev_message: The download page has been opened.
settings.ext.firefox_dev_detail:
After installing and opening Developer Edition, come back to MDM and press «Install Firefox automatically» again — a permanent install will be performed.

If you want to continue with regular Firefox for now, you can choose «Install temporarily» from the same button.
settings.ext.firefox_error_message: The installation could not be started.
settings.keyboard.title: In-app shortcuts
settings.keyboard.copy_files: Copy selected files to the clipboard
settings.keyboard.copy_files_hint: When enabled, the selected completed downloads are placed on the clipboard as files; you can paste them into Explorer or another app with Ctrl+V.
settings.keyboard.hotkey_hint: To change the shortcut press «Change», then press the keys.
settings.keyboard.delete_key: Allow the Delete key to delete inside the app
settings.keyboard.delete_key_hint: When enabled, the Delete key deletes the selected files, archives, and categories.
settings.keyboard.capture_hint: Esc cancels. For example Ctrl+C or Ctrl+Shift+C
settings.keyboard.reset_done: The default shortcut has been restored.
settings.keyboard.need_modifier: Use at least one modifier (Ctrl / Alt / Shift).

settings.advanced.reset_hint: Every field in this section returns to its installation value. Other settings are untouched.
settings.advanced.reset_done_detail: Press Save to keep the change.
settings.update.title: Application update
settings.update.hint: Updates are only checked from here; the app does not search automatically on every start.
